title: CMA CEO Shares What Fans Can Expect From 60th CMA Awards and Why Lainey Wilson Is the ‘Perfect Person’ To Host
line: CMA CEO Sarah Trahern says the 60th CMA Awards will spotlight the '90s country stars who still influence today's artists, with Lainey Wilson hosting. Cue the cowboy hats and big hair.

title: Hudson Westbrook reveals tracklist for new album ‘Made You Look’
line: Hudson Westbrook revealed the tracklist for his new album 'Made You Look.' Time to start picking favorites.

title: Ella Langley closes Dandelion Tour in Saint Paul on 31 October
line: Ella Langley closes her Dandelion Tour in Saint Paul on Oct. 31. What a way to end a tour.

title: Luke Bryan Cut Zach John King From 'Idol' — Now They're Touring
line: Luke Bryan cut Zach King from 'American Idol,' and years later King is touring with him. Turns out the cut was just the opening act.

title: Jon Pardi, Zach Top, Thomas Rhett, Hudson Westbrook And More To Perform At 2027 Country Thunder Wisconsin Festival
line: Jon Pardi, Zach Top, Thomas Rhett and Hudson Westbrook will perform at the 2027 Country Thunder Wisconsin Festival. Wisconsin is about to get twangy.

title: Under The Big Sky Fest Reveals 2027 Lineup
line: The Under The Big Sky Fest revealed its 2027 lineup, led by Zach Bryan and Kacey Musgraves. Start saving now.

title: Country star Pat Green to release live album recorded in iconic Texas hall
line: Country star Pat Green will release a live album recorded in an iconic Texas hall. Boots and bleachers, all in one record.

title: Jess Moskaluke to make Opry debut as part of CCMA’s 50th birthday celebration
line: Canadian singer Jess Moskaluke will make her Grand Ole Opry debut as part of the Canadian Country Music Association's 50th birthday celebration. Canada's sending its best to Nashville.

title: Morgan Wallen Curates His Own 24/7 SiriusXM Channel, Morgan Wallen Radio
line: Morgan Wallen now curates his own 24/7 SiriusXM channel, Morgan Wallen Radio. Finally, a station that never skips a request.

title: Cody Johnson Used to Drive to Other Towns Just to Fight Cowboys
line: Cody Johnson says he used to drive to other towns just to fight cowboys before winning country music's biggest awards. Glad he found a better hobby.

title: Ella Langley Becomes The 4th Artist In Country Music History To Score Four #1 Hits In A Calendar Year
line: Ella Langley became the fourth artist in country music history to score four number one hits in a single calendar year. She's running out of records to break.

title: Lainey Wilson to Host 60th CMA Awards Solo, Celebrating 60 Years of Country Music
line: Lainey Wilson will host the 60th CMA Awards solo, celebrating 60 years of country music. No co-host, no problem.

title: Zach Top Adds New Arena Dates to ‘Cold Beer & Country Music Tour’
line: Zach Top added new arena dates to his Cold Beer & Country Music Tour. Time to start checking the calendar.

title: Country Splash to Debut in Cabo With Riley Green, Jon Pardi, DIPLO
line: Riley Green and Jon Pardi will headline Country Splash in Cabo alongside DIPLO. Sand in your boots instead of dirt.

title: Zac Brown Band, Russell Dickerson, Jo Dee Messina and More to Rock Daytona for Ford's First Veterans Day Classic
line: Zac Brown Band, Russell Dickerson and Jo Dee Messina will play Daytona for Ford's first Veterans Day Classic. Start your engines and your guitars.

title: Lady A Surprises Fans With Moving New Song ‘Bigger Picture,’ Setting The Stage For Their 10th Studio Album
line: Lady A surprised fans with a new song, "Bigger Picture," that sets up their 10th studio album. Ten albums and still full of surprises.

title: ABC’s ‘Celebration’ of Dolly Parton and Her ‘Eternal’ Contributions
line: Reba McEntire, Oprah Winfrey and Sabrina Carpenter joined ABC's celebration honoring Dolly Parton's life and legacy. Dolly would say the more the merrier.

title: Garth Brooks releases Double Live on vinyl for first time 6 November
line: Garth Brooks is releasing Double Live on vinyl for the first time on Nov. 6. Dust off the turntable.

title: Barefoot Country Music Festival 2027 lineup revealed: Carrie Underwood, more
line: Carrie Underwood headlines the 2027 Barefoot Country Music Festival lineup. Pack the flip-flops early.

title: Georgia football lands quarterback commit Bo Bryan, son of country star Luke Bryan
line: Georgia football landed quarterback commit Bo Bryan, son of country star Luke Bryan. Dad's biggest hit may be his kid's arm.

title: Cody Johnson Brings Out Parker McCollum For Live Rendition Of "Good Time Charlie's Got The Blues" During London Show
line: Cody Johnson brought out Parker McCollum to sing 'Good Time Charlie's Got the Blues' at his London show. Country goes international.

title: Fans Praise Carly Pearce’s National Anthem Performance at World Series Game 3
line: Carly Pearce sang the national anthem before Game 3 of the World Series, and fans praised her strong, rich vocals. Home run of a performance.

title: Garth Brooks Announces Two Hamilton Concerts at TD Coliseum in December 2026, His First Canadian Stop on 'Blame It All On My Roots' Arena Tour
line: Garth Brooks announced two Hamilton, Ontario concerts at TD Coliseum in December, his first Canadian stop on the Blame It All On My Roots tour. Friends in cold places.

title: George Strait, Lyle Lovett, and Taylor Swift Join Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame
line: George Strait gave a rare speech as he received the Career Maker Award, and Taylor Swift and Lyle Lovett joined the Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame. The King still has the floor.

title: NBC To Air Special Broadcast Of Alan Jackson’s Final Concert In December
line: NBC will air a special broadcast of Alan Jackson's final concert in December, from the Last Call: One More For the Road finale. Set your DVR to country.

title: Country star Terri Clark says her band thinks she needs therapy for her fishing addiction | OutKick
line: Country star Terri Clark says her band thinks she needs therapy for her fishing addiction. Tell them it's a reel problem.

title: Riley Green Forced to Make ‘Extremely Difficult’ Decision Between Cade Mower and Brayden Howell in ‘The Voice’ Battle
line: Riley Green had an 'extremely difficult' call choosing between Cade Mower and Brayden Howell in a Battle round on The Voice. Never an easy chair to turn.

title: Listen to Eric Church’s reflective new single “On The Road”
line: Eric Church released a reflective new single called 'On The Road.' Pack a playlist.

title: Walker Montgomery Marries Tigirlily Gold's Krista Slaubaugh
line: Walker Montgomery married Tigirlily Gold's Krista Slaubaugh, with handwritten vows over morning coffee and a George Strait classic. Now that's a country wedding.

title: Chris Young’s Next Chapter Is Here: Country Star Signs With UTA
line: Country star Chris Young signed with United Talent Agency. New chapter, same great voice.
